pathways.title: Family Legacy By Design
pathways.description: Let a meaningful conversation become a shared family practice.
steps: Begin with one free session, its discussion guide, and seven devotionals when the sample package is ready.
Continue with the full masterclass, full-color curriculum, and a planned 200-page family devotional.
Use the approved 24-question assessment and a confirmed family profile to plan personalization.
Choose an individual resource, a personalized edition, or All Access when approved products are available.
pathways.status: Offer design recorded. Sample files, assessment instrument, personalized content and approved product configuration still require verification.

pathways.title: One message, all week long
pathways.audience: Pastors, families, groups, and ministry teams
pathways.description: Connect Sunday teaching to daily reflection, conversation, and action across the church.
steps: Begin with the actual sermon and approved teaching source.
Prepare daily devotions and an optional 90-second contribution from a ministry leader.
Adapt family conversations for preschool, elementary, and youth; prepare the group and leader editions.
Collect voluntary responses and stories; offer print and digital participation.
Extend into a 21-, 30-, or 40-day campaign with a continuation plan.
pathways.status: Production pathway defined. Use the shared workspace to develop and review each actual edition.

pathways.title: Flourishing LifeTogether
pathways.audience: Individuals, families, churches, and workplace teams
pathways.description: Connect health, faith, emotional well-being, relationships, financial wisdom, and purpose through practical shared journeys.
steps: Choose a specific felt need and willing participants.
Select a bounded journey with clear routines and relationship practices.
Adapt the setting for a church, workplace, or family while preserving the approved teaching.
Review participation and follow-through before expanding the program.
pathways.status: Program concepts for development. No clinical outcome or research endorsement is implied.

pathways.title: Ask, reflect, and take a next step
pathways.description: Two distinct question experiences have been specified.
steps: Ask Brett and Tom: collect questions by session and topic for a private team review.
AI companion: retrieve approved teaching, show its sources, and help prepare a practical family resource.
Let participants review their profile and choose what to share with an advisor.
Schedule devotionals from the chosen start date with pause, resume, and one active journey.
pathways.status: Implementation requirements recorded. A live team inbox, AI answers and automated email delivery are not enabled by this catalog.
